sampling_manifest.allocation_method: Proportional largest remainder over eligible rows: floor each quota, then assign remaining slots by descending fractional remainder; require at least one per nonempty source.

sampling_manifest.sample_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 fields joined by one NUL byte
sampling_manifest.sample_hash_formula: sha256(seed_string + NUL + source_id + NUL + str(one_based_source_row_number) + NUL + str(source_record_id) + NUL + str(pmid_or_empty) + NUL + str(stored_smiles_or_empty))
sampling_manifest.within_source_selection: Sort eligible rows lexicographically by (sample_hash, zero_based_physical_row_index), then take the allocated prefix.
